item.title: Oakland County school boards consider asking voters for enhancement millage
item.description: School districts across Oakland County are being asked to consider a resolution that would put an enhancement millage question before voters in August.

item.title: Detroit Lions fans' viral Super Bowl encounter earns team recognition
item.description: A chance encounter between Detroit Lions fans and a celebrity couple at the Super Bowl has captured hearts across social media and caught the attention of the Lions organization itself.

item.title: 'So scary': Woman describes alleged attack by man she met on Facebook Dating app
item.description: Jakayla Archie says she was stabbed multiple times by a man she met on the Facebook Dating app, and the suspect now faces charges in multiple other domestic violence cases.
